svg.title: Transactional writing
svg.desc: A job for the reader: Purpose: inform, advise, argue, persuade, discuss or review. Decide what the reader should understand or do. Audience + form + tone shape your choices. An advice article needs help, not a sales pitch. Protect both tasks: Two compulsory tasks: 20 marks each. Communication/organisation 12; language accuracy 8. Recent papers suggest 300–400 words and 30 minutes each. Plan, write and leave checking time. Ideas need substance: Choose distinct points. Ask why, how, what example, what consequence? A few developed ideas are stronger than repeating a general claim. Use credible details, not invented research. Give paragraphs jobs: Opening → clear direction. Middle → develop ideas in a useful order. Ending → judgement, recommendation or next step. Coherence: whole piece makes sense. Cohesion: its parts connect. Voice & form: Article: headline and connected prose. Letter: greeting, purpose and sign-off. Speech: words listeners can follow. Review: detail + judgement + reasons. Advice: action + how + why. Adapt register to the reader. Control, then edit: Use precise vocabulary and varied sentences for meaning. Devices must serve the idea. Check relevance, development, paragraph links, tone, sentence boundaries, agreement, tense and spelling.
